as_of_definition: max(Permit Issue Date, Permit Valid From) over the whole register
caveat: A valid permit is not proof that the bus operates.
privacy: counts only; no registration number, name or row-level record is written; no cell suppressed

route_recorded_definition.both_ends: From Location and To Location are both non-blank
route_recorded_definition.either_end: From Location or To Location is non-blank on the permit row

vehicle_rule: n_vehicles counts distinct registration numbers within the division scope (Kashmir Division offices / all other offices); a vehicle with several permit rows in a scope takes the attributes of its latest permit there; a vehicle with permits in both scopes is counted once in each
